# Production YOLO model version registry
#
# This file pins which trained model the inference code (detector.py,
# scripts/auto_annotate_ls.py, GPU worker) should load. On startup, those
# entry points should refuse to run if the on-disk model's sha256 does not
# match the entry for the version listed here.
#
# Download from GitHub Releases:
#   https://github.com/Qong-Systems/qong_product/releases/tag/<version>
#
# Adding a new version: append a row below, do NOT edit existing rows.
# Format:  <version>\t<filename>\t<sha256>

current: v1-11

versions:
  v1-11:
    notes: |
      Trained 2026-06-15 on AWS g5.2xlarge (A10G), yolov8s, imgsz=640, 100 epochs.
      ~32,212 LS-sourced annotations (812 train + 80 val tiles), ~+32% more
      annotation than v1-10, concentrated on the weak arrow/connector and
      valve_ck/gt/gl classes flagged in FEATURES #30. Same 23-class layout as
      v1-10 (drop-in swap — no inference code change).
      mAP50 = 0.805 vs v1-10 = 0.745 on the SAME (leak-free) v1-11 val split
      (+0.060); recall 0.682 -> 0.759; precision flat. Biggest per-class gains:
      direction arrows (arrow_up 0.426 -> 0.673, arrow_right 0.403 -> 0.653) and
      valve_ck 0.57 -> 0.76, valve_gt 0.77 -> 0.87, Motor 0.80 -> 0.94.
      NOTE: the v1-10 0.834 in its own notes was on v1-10's easier 62-image val
      set — not comparable; 0.745 is v1-10 re-scored on the v1-11 val set.
      ONNX export needed an onnxscript upgrade on the g5 AMI (torch 2.12).
    files:
      best.pt:   (in s3://qong-pid-archive-2026-06-02/training/v1-11/best.pt)
      best.onnx: 34022c917ae3b5487b6a81d9cc9f12064efdd101ee96540a1c7dd0fec097f4e5

  v1-10:
    notes: |
      Trained 2026-06-05 on AWS g5.2xlarge (A10G), yolov8s, imgsz=640, 100 epochs.
      24,428 LS-sourced annotations (605 train + 62 val). First 23-class layout
      (added 6 direction labels). mAP50 = 0.834 on its own 62-image val set.
      Deployed 2026-06-05 (FEATURES #30) but never recorded in this registry
      until the v1-11 promotion — superseded by v1-11.
    files:
      best.onnx: 896e42561fddd8014fd6021176ce903a5bb0afeffa3717b436e32a56c19e3142
  v1-9:
    notes: |
      Trained 2026-05-25 on Windows GPU (RTX 2000 Ada).
      845 train + 49 val tiles from 26 LS projects (added 7, 26, 27, 28 vs v1-8),
      including 442 oversampled tiles for rare instrument classes (DCS 4x, PLC 5x,
      interlock 5x, valve_gl 5x, valve_3way_relief 3x). nc=20 — dropped 3 empty
      actuator classes, added valve_gt (gate valve, 556 instances previously dropped).
      57 epochs (early stopped at 27), mAP50 = 0.404 on diverse val set.
      Per-class recall: valve_ck 87%, valve_bf 80%, valve_gt 87%, valve_bv 75%,
      DCS 62%, inst_field 62%, PLC 41%, valve_3way_relief 6% (regressed).
      NOTE: val set is 49 random tiles across 26 drawing styles — much harder
      than v1-7/v1-8's MUK-only 9-image val. mAP not directly comparable.
    files:
      best.pt:   (unknown — not transferred from Windows GPU)
